english.note: Use 溶 as the all-purpose everyday verb for something melting into liquid or disappearing into a liquid.
This is the all-purpose spoken choice for a solid becoming liquid and for something physically dissolving.
Use 溶 when heat turns a solid into a liquid.

examples.english: The sugar will dissolve as soon as it goes into hot water.

examples.english: The ice cream is starting to melt.
